phases.name: Shared locale layer and server messages

tasks.title: Add the shared locale and error catalogue
tasks.description: Add packages/shared/src/i18n.ts with SUPPORTED_LOCALES, negotiateLocale(header) and ERROR_MESSAGES for en/ar/fr; export it from the package index.

tasks.title: Localize the exception filter
tasks.description: Update HttpExceptionFilter to negotiate Accept-Language and return the localized message for the stable code, keeping code, details and requestId; localize the validation summary and keep an unknown code's existing message.

tasks.title: Send Accept-Language from the client
tasks.description: Add an axios request interceptor that sends Accept-Language from i18n.language at request time.

tasks.title: Add a localized generic error fallback
tasks.description: Add a localized generic error string to en/ar/fr and use it in getErrorMessage when the server code is unknown.

tasks.title: Add the shared Intl formatters
tasks.description: Add packages/shared/src/format.ts with date/time/number/currency formatters that take the locale and clinic timezone and fall back to UTC.

tasks.title: Expose the clinic timezone
tasks.description: Add clinicTimezone to MembershipView in TenancyService.listMemberships and to the backoffice membership type.

tasks.title: Migrate formatting to the shared helpers
tasks.description: Replace the ad-hoc formatting in OverviewPage, StaffDirectoryPage, DatePicker and TimePicker with the shared helpers.

tasks.title: Run lint, typechecks, shared build and governance checks
tasks.description: Run server and backoffice lint and typecheck, build @riaya/shared, sdrive verify and validate-governance.js; all must pass. Do not run the test suite.

tasks.title: Confirm no locale-less formatting remains
tasks.description: Grep the backoffice for argument-less toLocaleString/toLocaleDateString/toLocaleTimeString on user-facing values, confirm no dependency or lockfile change, and record the result.
